consent.title: We value your privacy
consent.body: We only use cookies that are strictly necessary for the site to function, plus an optional language preference. We do not use analytics or marketing cookies. You can change your choice at any time via the "Manage cookies" link in the footer.
consent.necessary_desc: Required for sign-in, cart and security. Cannot be turned off.
consent.preferences_desc: Stores your language choice (Swedish or English) between visits.
